<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=How's It Going?|id=A0006}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
It's really useful to know how to start a conversation in order to have one! Liliana and JP talk about all we need: greetings, compliments, and how to respond to them. The keyword is '''guapa''' – beautiful (for feminine nouns). 
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0007|A0007: Where are you from?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0016|A0016: I feel sick]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0086|A0086: Are you single?]]}}
<noinclude>{{SbcAudioLojbanPod|title=How's it going?|id=A0006|dialogueid=A0006 dialogue}}</noinclude>
{{SbcDialogueLojbanPod}}

|-
|align="right"|''hombre:'' || '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo te va?'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0006 line 1}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''mujer:'' || '''Bien, bien. ¿Y tú? ¿Qué tal?'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0006 line 2}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''hombre:'' || '''Todo bien, gracias.'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0006 line 3}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''mujer:'' || '''Me alegra.'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0006 line 4}}</noinclude>
|-
|}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo te va?'''
| Hello, beautiful! How is it going for you?
| '''Bien, bien. ¿Y tú? ¿Qué tal?'''
| Good, good. And you, how are you?
| '''Todo bien, gracias.'''
| Everything's fine, thanks.
| '''Me alegra.'''
| That makes me happy.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo te va?'''
| Hello, beautiful! How is it going for you?
| '''Bien, bien. ¿Y tú? ¿Qué tal?'''
| Good, good. And you, how are you?
| '''Todo bien, gracias.'''
| Everything's fine, thanks.
| '''Me alegra.'''
| That makes me happy.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hello, beautiful (feminine)! How is it going for you?  | '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo te va?'''
| Good, good. And you? How are you? | '''Bien, bien. ¿Y tú? ¿Qué tal?'''
| Everything's fine, thanks. | '''Todo bien, gracias.'''
| That makes me happy. | '''Me alegra.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Hello, beautiful (feminine)! How is it going for you?  | '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo te va?'''
| Good, good. And you? How are you? | '''Bien, bien. ¿Y tú? ¿Qué tal?'''
| Everything's fine, thanks. | '''Todo bien, gracias.'''
| That makes me happy. | '''Me alegra.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hello, handsome (masculine)! | '''¡Hola, guapo!'''
| Hello, ugly (feminine)! How are you? | '''¡Hola, fea! ¿Cómo te va?''' (or: '''¿Qué tal?''')
| Everything's fine. Thanks, ugly (masculine). And you? | '''Todo bien. Gracias, feo. ¿Y tú?'''
| Good. Everything goes fine. | '''Bien. Todo va bien.'''
| How good! I'm delighted. | '''¡Qué bien! Me alegra.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Hello, handsome (masculine)! | '''¡Hola, guapo!'''
| Hello, ugly (feminine)! How are you? | '''¡Hola, fea! ¿Cómo te va?''' (or: '''¿Qué tal?''')
| Everything's fine. Thanks, ugly (masculine). And you? | '''Todo bien. Gracias, feo. ¿Y tú?'''
| Good. Everything goes fine. | '''Bien. Todo va bien.'''
| How good! I'm delighted. | '''¡Qué bien! Me alegra.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| Hello, beautiful (feminine)! How is it going for you? (formal)  | '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo le va?'''
| Good, good. And you? How are you? (formal) | '''Bien, bien. ¿Y usted? ¿Qué tal?'''
| Everything's fine, thanks. | '''Todo bien, gracias.'''
| That makes us happy. | '''Nos alegra.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Hello, beautiful (feminine)! How is it going for you? (formal)  | '''¡Hola, guapa! ¿Cómo le va?'''
| Good, good. And you? How are you? (formal) | '''Bien, bien. ¿Y usted? ¿Qué tal?'''
| Everything's fine, thanks. | '''Todo bien, gracias.'''
| That makes us happy. | '''Nos alegra.'''
}}</includeonly>
